name: Olula de Castro (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper fly, white above and green below, charged in the upper hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Olula de Castro (a tree and a sheep on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Olula de Castro; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Olula de Castro arms — tree and sheep on blue
